invariants.rationale: The return value of IOUtils.runMerge is expected to be a non-null Iterator.
fileId is required for getUpdateHandle and runMerge calls; a null fileId would likely result in an exception before returning.
oldDataFile is required for constructing the HoodieMergeHandle and is thus expected to be non-null at method exit.
keyToNewRecords must be non-null to perform an update operation.
instantTime is passed into both getUpdateHandle and runMerge; these operations are not meaningful with a null value.
